craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of demolition and retorsion — utsāha as each counterfeit falls and the proof-text turns witness. Retorsion turns: no-mere-thought + snake-error kept (analogy load-bearing); past-remedy end-weight. Rejected: (a) modernizing snake-error → killed: analogy is doctrine-vehicle. (b) dismissed→refuted → killed: L3 frozen. Read aloud: NO-mere-THOUGHT, THIS — IT-can-NOT be dis-MISSED … PAST-rem-e-dy.

lines: No mere thought, this — it cannot be dismissed:
like snake-error, clinging to a shining, past remedy.

reads_against.argmap: Is the joining only thought's fabrication? → Retorsion begins: unwardability proves the joining is no mere fabrication.
c1_essence: Relation's counterfeits are refused one by one — awaiting, two-seatedness, uninterruptedness need a consciousness they deny — until form-fusion stands: the many's one-selfhood (vv1-5).
The Buddhist proof-text is turned against its makers: unmixed things thought-joined is no mere thought but unwardable shining-clinging, warrantable in recognition's path (vv6-9).
